scope: Exact source-path relocation of reviewed current capability declarations; not hardware or runtime qualification.

buffered_ring_receive.scope: Direct BufferedUartRx/BufferedUart owners provide continuous IRQ receive collection into bounded RX rings; safe constructors consume static storage, while unsafe new_borrowed variants tie ordinary buffer borrows to owner Drop (combined split halves share a lifetime).
limitations: Existing 54 selections retain their package routes and exclusions; source/API scope is not a build-total claim.

Inherent and async trait reads return an available clean prefix; read_exact fills the slice. Nonwaiting blocking_read and read_ready are available. Empty reads preserve queued bytes and pending errors.

Async BufRead fill_buf lends a contiguous occupied prefix without copying; consume releases only exposed bytes. IRQ writes remain disjoint from the held prefix, but prolonged borrowing can cause overflow.

Safe constructors consume the nonempty static ring even on constructor error and do not return it; unsafe borrowed constructors release the borrow after normal RX Drop and the shared TX/RX lifetime ends, and require storage to remain valid and exclusive if the owner is leaked.
Retained clean prefix precedes the first pending error; software BufferOverflow and line errors discard later ISR observations until the error is consumed.
Ten non-L010/L011/L012 families permit silent pre-ISR RDR overwrite even with ring space; native ORE does not count lost frames, and NE requires 16x/8x sampling.
Collection depends on IRQ progress; finite capacity does not guarantee lossless reception, bounded waits or throughput.
Hardware RTS reflects RC rather than software queue occupancy; no ring-watermark backpressure is provided.
No buffered idle markers, DMA ring, numeric timeout or storage-reclamation API.

limitations: First nonempty poll clears stale idle only; unread RC/data and errors remain available.

safe_peripheral_dma.scope: Safe staged TX, finite RX and combined/split UART DMA on F030/A030/L083 and fourteen exact F020/L031/L052/R031/W031 parts; exact L012 C8T6/C8U6 remain UART TX-only.
limitations: Every admitted profile requires qualified SRAM and normal reset/clean-runtime startup; static UART/channel/staging owners are consumed. Generic classic aliases retain MissingMemoryMetadata rejection.
CPU copy per byte and possible chunk gaps; write completes memory-to-TDR transfer and flush separately waits for the wire.
Cancellation retains each direction's current chunk; clean RX tails remain available, and TE or ambiguous completion permanently quarantines resources.
RX gaps may lose frames with no overrun indication; FE/PE reports promptly but recovery waits for the old DMA count.
TX requires TX, RX requires RX, combined construction requires both signals and independent static staging/channels.
No DMA RTS/CTS, continuous RX, borrowed zero-copy, early abort, throughput or finite-liveness guarantee.
